review_input.original_instruction: You are standing facing a wall and doorway.  You are going to go thru this door. And you are going to see a staircase to your right.  You are going to hop over the staircase heading in the direction to your right.  You have landed on some stairs. You are going to go up the steps.  And you are going to head to your left going down this pathway.  You will come into a corner there will be a mirror on your right.  Continue heading down this hallway.  There will be an archway in front of you.  You are going to go thru this archway and then make a right.  You will see a large room with a pool table.  You are going to head to the right of the pool table and make your way thru this room heading towards the open door at the end of the room. You are going to go thru the door and veer to your left.  You will talk thru this room with the navy curtains on your right.  You are going to head towards the fireplace.  And you are going to stop once you have reached the spot with the navy curtains on your right and you will be facing the arched window on the wall and on the left of you you are going to be lined almost exactly up with the square ottoman and you are done.
